_fixture.what: Hand-built stand-in for the history the SI ledger backfill reads: rows of agentcore-hub-workflow-analyses and the [SI] PRD objects under s3://$ARTIFACT_BUCKET/workflow-manager/synthesized-prds/. NOT a capture - it is sized and shaped so every branch of classify()/buildPlan() is pinned by one record.

shape.analyses: one row per analysed run: workflowId, analysisId, createdAt, workflowDefId, findings[], recommendations[]
shape.prds: one [SI] PRD object per attempt: key (its S3 key), title, description, sources[], and an optional run{} block
shape.existingRows: rows already in agentcore-hub-si-ledger before the backfill runs

cases.wf_sd01..wf_sd31: 31 runs whose analyses each name the SAME pattern (harness silent death) in a DIFFERENT way - 'went silent', 'died mid-turn', 'no spans', 'dropped silently', 'stopped emitting spans'. This is the pattern the feature exists for: one ask made 31 times. 24 of them carry a second, unrelated item so a run contributes to more than one key.
cases.wf_ok01..wf_ok07: 7 runs with no silent death at all - they carry the remaining patterns (timeout, dispatch stall, lease leak, cascade gap, orchestrator scope creep, self-park, rework loop, missing evidence, QA gap, human wait, CI flake, deploy gate, build failure, intake scope, coding session loss, coding deps, trace gap, token burn, duplicate tickets).
cases.wf_ok08: the NEGATIVES-only run - 'shipped ahead of schedule' and 'keep the summary at the top' name no systemic pattern, so classify() must return null and buildPlan must list them under `skipped` rather than invent a key.
cases.6 silent-death PRDs: the six real attempts at the pattern, with mixed outcomes on purpose: 3 deployed, 2 landed (merged, never deployed), and TEAM-4734 STILL RUNNING - no mergedAt and no completedAt, so it must land on `in-run`, not `landed`. Replayed oldest-first, the ROW therefore ends `in-run`: applyAttempt assigns statusAfterOutcome(outcome) on every stamp, so a key's status is what its newest attempt says, not the furthest any attempt got. That is what keeps dedupeBlocked from filing a seventh PRD while the sixth is still running.
cases.system-20260820T093000.json: the PRECEDENCE case: its description says 'human gate', but it names the DEPLOY gate, so it must classify as pipeline.deploy-gate and not the generic gate.human-wait. Swap those two entries in PATTERNS and this record fails.
cases.system-20260828T171000.json: a PRD with no run block at all - written, never started. There is NO attempt to record: attempts[] is keyed on the run that carried one and `batched` is not an ATTEMPT_OUTCOMES member, so applyAttempt would throw - and replaying it as a `batched` status write would downgrade its pattern (gate.human-wait), an existing `verified` row, because applyStatus does not rank. It must appear under `skipped` with reason `prd-never-run` and write nothing.
cases.system-20260912T083000.json: a cosmetic PRD that matches no pattern - the PRD-side negative case.
cases.existingRows[gate.human-wait]: already `verified` with its own title and 2 occurrences. The backfill must APPEND its 3 new occurrences, keep the status `verified`, and keep the original title - a merge, never a clobber.
cases.existingRows[pipeline.build-failure]: already `landed`; nothing in the backfill promotes it, so it stays `landed` (the mid-rank no-downgrade case).

expected.idempotent: folding the plan back into existingRows and re-running emits 0 writes

prds.description: Three runs in this batch lost a phase to a silent death. Reap on span silence and re-dispatch once.

prds.title: system: reap and re-dispatch runs that went silent
prds.description: The 15-minute silence window is the only signal we get; act on it in the reaper.

prds.title: system: detect a silent death with an in-container commands probe
prds.description: Ask the container what the CLI process is doing instead of trusting the invocation.

prds.title: system: a silently terminated turn must still leave a completion record
prds.description: Completion evidence is what the orchestrator reads; a dead turn leaves none.

prds.title: system: no spans means dead - shorten the reaper window
prds.description: Runs sat dead for 20+ minutes before the reaper noticed. Tighten it.

prds.title: system: silent death on the ship phase (TEAM-4734)
prds.description: Sixth attempt at this pattern. Still open when the ledger was introduced.

prds.title: system: converge the review/fix rework loop in one round
prds.description: Sibling defects must close as a class, not one round each.

prds.title: system: agents self-park behind their own fix tickets
prds.description: DL-011: whoever finds the defect files it and parks itself; routing stays routing.

prds.title: system: the deploy gate must never be skipped on an unproven head

prds.title: system: human approval gates sit idle overnight
